skills.name: Scala Optional Library Module Lookup
skills.description: Reference skill for mapping Scala optional standard library modules to their corresponding JAR artifacts. Enables developers to identify which separate library packages are needed and their artifact names for build configuration.
skills.skill_body:
Consult this reference to identify which optional Scala standard library modules are needed for your project and map them to their JAR artifact names. Each module is shipped separately and must be explicitly added to your build configuration or classpath.

## Objective

Provide lookup mapping between Scala optional modules and their JAR artifacts
## Applicable Signals

- Build configuration phase
- Dependency resolution step
- Scala environment setup

## Contraindications

- Runtime code execution
- Dynamic module loading at runtime
- Module version conflict resolution

## Constraints

- Reference only; does not execute module loading
- Modules listed are optional and must be explicitly included
- JAR artifacts must be available in build repository or local classpath

## Output Contract

- Documented mapping of optional Scala modules to their JAR files, enabling caller to add required artifacts to build configuration or classpath
